description: Q5 (Top-K exercise): manual (SelectionStep) vs. builtin (FindExtremum) vs. novel taxonomic split, cross-validated against codet5p-110m-embedding.
generation_method: labeled = report[report['structural_label'].isin(['manual','builtin','novel'])].reset_index(drop=True); for seed in range(10): shuffled = labeled.sample(frac=1, random_state=seed).reset_index(drop=True); split_point = int(len(shuffled) * 0.7); train = shuffled.iloc[:split_point]; test = shuffled.iloc[split_point:]
structural_label_rule: manual if SelectionStep_final >= 0.99; elif builtin if FindExtremum_final >= 0.99; elif novel if FindExtremum_final == 0; else excluded ('partial')
source_report_csv: topk_report.csv (from batch_report.py's Q5 run, pulled from Drive, 526 rows)
reported_metric: manual/builtin accuracy: mean=0.870, std=0.023 (pooled over the 10 seeds' test predictions) -- confirmed verbatim in the notebook's executed output
